model.title: Proposal for a DECISION OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL renewing a Union action for the European Capitals of Culture for the years 2034 to 2047 and repealing Decision No 445/2014/EU

summary.text: This proposal aims to continue a cultural programme that designates certain European cities as Capitals of Culture for a future period. It would replace the current rules governing this initiative with updated provisions for the extended timeframe.

asOf.note: the most recent action in the official record. Status can lag; each step below carries its own date.

whatsNext.text: Parliament's lead committee and the Council's working party examine it in parallel. No deadline applies at this stage; most files take one to two-plus years.
